theme: श्रद्धा से आराधना; Devotion becomes practice when faith is steady.
context: Krishna continues the teaching of the previous verse. The devotee, supported by the faith Krishna makes firm, worships the chosen form and receives desired results from that worship. Krishna says those results are bestowed within His ordering. This verse states the sequence without evaluating how lasting those results are.
contextHindi: कृष्ण पिछले श्लोक की बात आगे बढ़ाते हैं। उनकी स्थिर की हुई श्रद्धा के साथ भक्त चुने हुए रूप की आराधना करता है और उससे इच्छित फल पाता है। कृष्ण कहते हैं कि वे फल उन्हीं की व्यवस्था में दिए जाते हैं। यह श्लोक अभी उन फलों के स्थायी या अस्थायी होने का मूल्यांकन नहीं करता।
sanskritDevanagari:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते |
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान् ||७-२२||
transliteration:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate .
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaivavihitānhi tān ||7-22||

wordByWord.meaning: he; the devotee as a person of intention and action.
endowed with faith; united with sincere trust and commitment.
worship, service, adoration; the actual practice of devotion.
ordained, arranged, set in order by the divine.

spokenHindi: पिछले श्लोक में कृष्ण ने कहा कि वे भक्त की श्रद्धा को स्थिर करते हैं। अब वे बताते हैं कि उस श्रद्धा के साथ भक्त चुने हुए रूप की आराधना करता है। ‘स तया श्रद्धया युक्तः’ का अर्थ है—वह उस श्रद्धा से जुड़ा हुआ है। ‘तस्य आराधनम् ईहते’—वह उस रूप की पूजा या आराधना करता है। फिर ‘लभते च ततः कामान्’—उसे उसी आराधना से अपनी इच्छित वस्तुएँ या फल मिलते हैं। अंत में कृष्ण कहते हैं, ‘मया एव विहितान् हि तान्’—वे प्राप्त फल मेरे ही द्वारा विधान किए गए हैं। यहाँ ‘कामान्’ को इच्छित वस्तुओं या परिणामों के अर्थ में पढ़ना उचित है; इसका अर्थ यह नहीं कि मन में उठने वाली हर इच्छा कृष्ण का आदेश है। इस श्लोक में उन फलों की अवधि या नैतिक मूल्य पर चर्चा नहीं की गई। मुख्य क्रम है: श्रद्धा, आराधना, इच्छित फल और कृष्ण की व्यापक व्यवस्था। इस तरह स्थिर श्रद्धा केवल भावना नहीं रहती; वह अभ्यास बनती है और उसके परिणाम भी स्वतंत्र, असंबद्ध संयोग नहीं माने जाते।
clearEnglish: Krishna continues the teaching of the previous verse. The devotee, joined with the faith Krishna has made firm, undertakes worship of the chosen form. The Sanskrit then says that the devotee obtains kāmān from that worship—desired objects, aims, or results—and that these are vihitān, allotted or ordained, by Krishna. The point is more precise than saying that every desire arising in the mind is a divine command. Rather, the results received through this devotional arrangement remain within Krishna’s encompassing order; the chosen deity is not presented as an independent source outside Him. The verse gives a sequence: faith becomes worship, worship bears a sought result, and that result is situated within divine governance. It does not yet assess the duration or ultimate value of the result. For practice, this encourages honest awareness of motive. One may bring a concrete hope into worship without disguising it as selfless devotion, while also remembering that neither ritual technique nor personal insistence places the divine under one’s control.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse says that the devotee worships the chosen form with the faith described previously, obtains the desired objects or results from that worship, and that Krishna has ordained those results.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse places worship and its desired results within Krishna’s ordering. It does not require the inference that every impulse is divinely approved or that a ritual mechanically compels a result.

practicalApplication.label: Notice your practice
practicalApplication.text: Choose a simple form of worship or remembrance, such as prayer, chanting, or service. Spend a few minutes with it each day this week. Notice what you hope for and how the practice feels, without judging yourself for having a desire.

reflectionQuestion: What result do you hope for in worship, and how can you hold that hope honestly without treating it as a demand that must be fulfilled?
reflectionQuestionHindi: आराधना में आप किस फल की आशा रखते हैं, और उसे अनिवार्य माँग बनाए बिना ईमानदारी से कैसे धारण कर सकते हैं?
